title: Open Learn
description: OpenLearn is a production-ready, TypeScript-powered backend designed for scalable cohort-based educational platforms. It supports structured learning paths, hierarchical roles, gamification, and real-time progress tracking, deployed using modern DevOps and containerized infrastructure.
full_description:
OpenLearn is a comprehensive backend system engineered for cohort-driven educational platforms. Built with TypeScript and Express, it enables institutions to manage structured curricula, track learner progress, assign roles, and foster engagement through badges, leaderboards, and analytics.

With advanced role-based access control (RBAC), OpenLearn supports a multi-tier hierarchy including students (Pioneers), educators (Pathfinders), and admins (Chief Pathfinders, Grand Pathfinders). Courses are delivered through specializations, leagues, and weekly sections—each with multi-format resources and assignments.

Gamification and social features are tightly integrated, offering badge systems, progress milestones, and social sharing. The platform includes deep analytics, audit logging, and health monitoring—ensuring visibility and reliability in real-time.

OpenLearn is built for performance and scalability with Dockerized deployment, PostgreSQL, Redis caching, background email workers, and a fully automated CI/CD pipeline.
features: ["Robust TypeScript backend for cohort-based learning with hierarchical role management","Integrated progress tracking, gamification, analytics, and multi-format content delivery","Dockerized, production-ready API with PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT auth, and real-time health monitoring"]

title: FernKit
description: FernKit is a modular ecosystem of low-level developer tools for C, C++, and Python—designed with minimalism, composability, and transparency at its core. Centered around a handcrafted UI toolkit (fern) for WASM and Linux, FernKit empowers developers to build visual applications, CLIs, and networking systems with full control and minimal overhead.
full_description:
FernKit is a minimalist, handcrafted software ecosystem for system-oriented developers. It includes a suite of small, composable tools—each themed around nature and growth—to help you build visual, textual, and networked applications from the ground up.

At its heart is fern, a modern UI toolkit written in C++ for rendering pixel-by-pixel visuals on WebAssembly and Linux. With an immediate-mode rendering engine, a responsive widget/layout system (Row, Column, Padding, etc.), and a signal-slot event system, fern lets you construct intuitive interfaces with zero external dependencies. It supports font rendering, primitive shapes, and live input handling, all within a clean, memory-efficient architecture.
features: ["Modular C/C++ ecosystem with minimal dependencies, handcrafted for full system-level control","Modern UI toolkit ('fern') featuring responsive layout primitives, pixel-level rendering, and signal-slot event handling","Cross-platform support for Linux and WebAssembly, with tools for CLI, networking, and text rendering built around a cohesive natural metaphor"]
